scarce_resource: Unix-stream collector append-admission budget at /run/provenance-ledger/ingest.sock with refill_rate=42 events/s and burst=5

expected_b_progress_signal: the root-owned grader independently recomputes 48 component/advisory joins and finds byte-semantic matching finding records, unique durable sequences, and receipts in the collector log at >=16 events/s

builder or signature-result coverage stopped advancing
